title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
summary: Gridded hourly historical weather reanalysis served by the Open-Meteo archive API. Probed at the register default point (45.46, 9.19, Milan area; returned grid point 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m). Variables requested in probes were temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m in UTC. It is a model product, not station observations, and is not a source of traffic or pollutant data. Both probe windows (2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12 and 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-02) returned data, so coverage of the prototype and production windows is confirmed at the probe level only.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Hourly timestamp, ISO8601 (returned without offset; timezone GMT when timezone=UTC requested)

fields.name: relative_humidity_2m
fields.description: Relative humidity at 2 m (must be requested explicitly; not in register default_query)

schema.notes: Other hourly variables exist in the API but were not probed. Response is JSON with hourly arrays plus hourly_units. Documentation URL https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api was not read.

spatial.code_system: decimal latitude/longitude (point query, snapped to model grid)
spatial.notes: Register default point 45.46, 9.19 (Milan area). The API returned grid point 45.448154, 9.169279. The client city (Valdena) is fictional and not located in any source read; the point must be confirmed and recorded in decisions.md before use. The register default is not Lisbon, contrary to the candidate's suspected_issues note.

access.request_process: Open GET to https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive with latitude, longitude, start_date, end_date, hourly, timezone. Keep probe ranges to a few days. Production use may need Legal sign-off under policy.open_data_links.

documentation_excerpts: Register param_notes: 'latitude/longitude decimal degrees; start_date/end_date YYYY-MM-DD; hourly or daily variable lists. Keep probe ranges to a few days.'
Licence page: 'API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)'

quality_notes: Model reanalysis, not station observations: humidity and temperature at 2 m may differ from station readings. Not a substitute for the city's own station data (production window).
Does not cover N1 (pollutants) or N2 (traffic); it only fits N3 (temperature and humidity).
Register default_query returns temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation only; relative_humidity_2m must be requested explicitly (confirmed by probe with the explicit variable list).

Probe sample 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-02 (45.448154, 9.169279): temperature_2m values 5.6, 6.1, 5.0 and relative_humidity_2m values 98, 96, 97; 48 hourly rows, no nulls in the visible values. Probe 2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12: temperature_2m -1.0, -1.0, -1.2 and relative_humidity_2m 85, 86, 87; 72 rows. Negative temperatures are plausible for March in northern Italy and are not sentinels. Only the first values were visible, so missing-value checks on the full ranges were not done.

Register and candidate disagree on the default location: the candidate note says the brief's default is Lisbon, but the register default is 45.46, 9.19 (Milan area). Neither is the client city; the city is not named in any source read.
Licence page header shows 'Last modified: Tue, 24 Nov 2026', which is after the use case as_of date of 2026-10-15; treat the page date as unverified.

Licence mixed: the API data is stated as CC BY 4.0, but the page separately lists C3S reanalysis under its own licence, which was not read. The C3S-derived series may carry Copernicus licence conditions. Commercial-use position is unknown.

provenance.claim: Endpoint https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive, register default point 45.46/9.19, default variables temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation, approved purposes prototyping and production, agreement not_required_open_data
API responds with hourly temperature and relative humidity for 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-02 (48 rows) and for 2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12 (72 rows); grid point 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m
